objections.title: The DR-105 edit leaves a second live clause falsely saying permission v2 remains owed
objections.finding: Live DR-105 contains two relevant statements in the same status cell. D-093 replaces the early `host-effect contract still required before host doctor acts` phrase with text that correctly records D-042/v2. It does not target the later unique clause `a permission v2 successor and the host-effect contract remain`. The subject's `Exact file-08 edits, and no others` rule therefore guarantees that stale clause survives. The resulting cell would simultaneously say `permission-truth-tables.v2 remains the accepted DR-105 design-contract candidate (D-042)` and `a permission v2 successor ... remain`, directly failing the prompt's D093-MF-1 attack.

The turn-2 subject contains no edit for that later occurrence.
